import pandas as pd

# --- Parsed output ---
output_text = "Strong battery life and a bright screen, but the speaker is weak."
response_schema = "text"
parsed = {"format": "plain text", "content": output_text, "schema_valid": True}

# --- Logprobs ---
logprobs_requested = False
logprobs = None  # not returned since not requested

# --- Usage (as reported by the server) ---
usage = {"prompt_tokens": 30, "completion_tokens": 40, "total_tokens": 70}

# --- Local accounting from earlier pipeline steps ---
local_prompt_tokens = 41          # system 12 + user 18 + template 11
local_completion_tokens = 12      # words in re-assembled summary

recon = pd.DataFrame([
    {"metric": "prompt_tokens",     "reported": usage["prompt_tokens"],     "local_estimate": local_prompt_tokens,     "delta": usage["prompt_tokens"] - local_prompt_tokens},
    {"metric": "completion_tokens", "reported": usage["completion_tokens"], "local_estimate": local_completion_tokens, "delta": usage["completion_tokens"] - local_completion_tokens},
    {"metric": "total_tokens",      "reported": usage["total_tokens"],      "local_estimate": local_prompt_tokens + local_completion_tokens, "delta": usage["total_tokens"] - (local_prompt_tokens + local_completion_tokens)},
])

print("=== Parsed Output ===")
print(f"schema={response_schema} | valid={parsed['schema_valid']}")
print(parsed["content"])

print("\n=== Logprobs ===")
print(f"requested={logprobs_requested} -> returned={logprobs}  (no reconciliation needed)")

print("\n=== Usage Reconciliation (reported vs local estimate) ===")
print(recon.to_string(index=False))

# --- Token accounting identity check ---
identity_ok = usage["prompt_tokens"] + usage["completion_tokens"] == usage["total_tokens"]
print(f"\nUsage identity (prompt + completion == total): {identity_ok}")

# --- Cost ---
price_input = None   # no rate provided in the contract
price_output = None
if price_input is None or price_output is None:
    print("\n=== Cost ===")
    print("Cannot compute: no per-token pricing was provided in the serving contract.")
    print("Cost = prompt_tokens*price_in + completion_tokens*price_out  (price_in/price_out unknown)")
else:
    cost = usage["prompt_tokens"]*price_input + usage["completion_tokens"]*price_output
    print(f"\nCost: {cost}")

print("\n=== FINAL SUMMARY ===")
print(output_text)
